name: Velociraptor DFIR
description: Velociraptor 기반 엔드포인트 포렌식 헌팅과 아티팩트 수집을 수행하는 DFIR 에이전트입니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description_en: Velociraptor DFIR forensic-hunting integration. Manages hunts, collects artifact results, and proxies the Velociraptor API for endpoint forensics and incident response. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.
author: SeCuardian

endpoints.description: Check Velociraptor server connectivity and version
Create a new forensic hunt (supervisor/admin only)
Get details of a specific hunt
Receive artifact results from Velociraptor (no JWT — Velociraptor callback)
Show current configuration (API key masked) — admin only

env_vars.name: VELOCIRAPTOR_URL
env_vars.description: Base URL of the Velociraptor server

env_vars.name: VELOCIRAPTOR_API_KEY
env_vars.description: X-API-Key for Velociraptor REST API authentication
